variety_description: A high yielding, Zinc enriched, medium maturity, semi dwarf, medium bold variety suitable for cultivation under irrigated lowland growing conditions. Developed by BRRI and released in 2014 for planting in Boro season. Derived from a cross IR68144 and BRRI dhan29. Strong plant type, lodging tolerant. Susceptible to major diseases and insect pests.
